title: Sungold Toast
description: The best way to eat fresh garden tomatoes
steps: Halve the cherry tomatoes and toss with olive oil and salt to taste in a mixing bowl
Toast sourdough till desired doneness, then immediately when hot, rub the halved garlic glove over the surface of the bread till fragrant.
Toss basil into tomatoes gently and spoon over the sliced sourdough toast.
